messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PGD-5893 fired for service=redwood-inference-prod endpoint=/v1/generate
incident-bot: Policy=\"inference-high-error-rate\" threshold=5% 5xx over 5m. Triggered at 2026-03-14T02:05:34Z. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PGD-5893
PagerDuty: Auto-page sent to primary: @Sam Nguyen (on-call)
Sam Nguyen: Acked. I'm on it — joining logs now. 
Sam Nguyen: Can someone confirm customer impact? Which regions/customers?
Maria Lopez: Seeing 5xx spike and latency 2x in eu-west-1, starts ~02:02. Affects embeddings + generate for a subset of enterprise tenants (high QPS). Some 429s too.
Priya Shah: PID correlation: gpu-pool-eu-12 shows repeated OOM events around 02:03. Batcher queue length spiked, KV cache allocations peaked.
Jordan Chen: If it's OOMs we should drain the node + reroute traffic to eu-west-2. Can someone prepare a canary shift?
Sam Nguyen: Doing a controlled reroute to eu-west-2, canary weight 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Will keep primary at reduced weight. ETA ~90s per step.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: No ack from secondary (Maria Lopez) within 3m; auto-escalating to manager Jordan Chen
PagerDuty: Manager page sent to @Jordan Chen
Jordan Chen: Joining bridge: zoom.us/j/999-888-777 (pin when you join). Adding myself to the bridge and Slack huddle.
Sam Nguyen: Running drain commands on gpu-pool-eu-12 now:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-pool-eu-12
kubectl drain node/gpu-pool-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
Sam Nguyen: Drain started. Redirecting new pods to eu-west-2. Monitoring pod restart loops.
Priya Shah: Quick config flip: setting KV_CACHE_ENABLED=false for inference-prod to reduce peak mem pressure (applied as a rollout to eu-west-1 replica set).
Maria Lopez: Confirmed logs: \"kv cache allocation failure\" around 02:03 on pod inference-ff87 (OOM kill shortly after). Matches OOM hypothesis.
Sam Nguyen: Canary traffic looks healthy in eu-west-2 — latency back to baseline for the canary group. Increasing canary to 50%.
Jordan Chen: Good. Please open a manager-level incident bridge if we need exec notif. For now we keep on-call bridge.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PGD-5893 acknowledged by Sam Nguyen — status set to investigating.
PagerDuty: Escalation note: secondary escalation attempted but primary acked before manager action required.
Sam Nguyen: Will keep monitoring for 30m. Post-incident owner: Maria Lopez (will lead postmortem + customer impact scan).
Maria Lopez: Filing incident ticket: https://internal/incidents/PGD-5893. Starting impact sweep across customer tenants (checking retries, failed requests, SLA exposure).
Priya Shah: Temporary mitigation summary: drained faulty node, disabled KV cache in prod for eu-west-1, increased canary weight to eu-west-2. Next steps: tune batching profile, add earlier OOM alert, revisit autoscaler cooldowns.
Jordan Chen: Takeaway: autoscaler delay + aggressive batching -> memory pressure -> OOM -> customer-visible 5xx. We'll adjust autoscale thresholds and add a runbook step to disable KV cache for memory OOM patterns.
Sam Nguyen: Thanks all. I'll close the PD incident once monitoring is stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: Incident PGD-5893 status: monitoring (auto-update).
Maria Lopez: I'll own the postmortem and tag affected customers. Will share draft in #product-notifications if customer outreach is required.
Priya Shah: Adding follow-up tasks to backlog: batcher tuning, kv cache fallback, OOM alarm threshold, autoscaler cooldown change.
Jordan Chen: Happy with mitigation. Marking manager escalation resolved on my side.
Sam Nguyen: Final note: if PD pages again, escalate to on-call manager immediately. Thanks team.
